In 50agents you tell Captain the job and it builds it on Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Razorpay and Gmail; every email to a customer waits for your approval.

faqs.a: Yes, WooCommerce is in viaSocket’s catalog with order, product and customer triggers. Name it in the sentence to Captain.

faqs.q: Can it send tracking emails automatically?
faqs.a: It drafts them and you approve. Shopify’s own shipping notifications are the right tool for automatic tracking emails.

faqs.q: Will it slow down my store?
faqs.a: No. It reads orders through Shopify’s app connection, not your storefront.

faqs.q: Can it tell a customer their refund is on the way?
faqs.a: It drafts the reply from what Shopify shows for that order, and you approve it before it goes. The refund itself stays with you: any change in Shopify asks you first.

faqs.q: What does it not do yet?
faqs.a: It does not cancel, refund or edit orders on its own; any change in Shopify asks you first. Customer replies go by email; it does not answer Instagram or WhatsApp messages today. A browser agent will not get past bot checks on competitor sites.
